subject: Língua Portuguesa
description_pt: Identificar assimilações, rupturas e permanências no processo de constituição da literatura brasileira e ao longo de sua trajetória, por meio da leitura e análise de obras fundamentais do cânone ocidental, em especial da literatura portuguesa, para perceber a historicidade de matrizes e procedimentos estéticos.

components.description_pt: Identificar assimilações e rupturas entre literatura brasileira e obras canônicas ocidentais fundacionais
components.description_en: Identify assimilations and ruptures between Brazilian literature and foundational Western canonical works
components.cc_component_description: Analyze how a specific cultural experience shapes meaning in a world literature text

components.description_pt: Rastrear continuidades em modelos estéticos ao longo da trajetória de formação literária brasileira
components.description_en: Trace continuities in aesthetic models across the trajectory of Brazilian literary formation
components.cc_component_description: Evaluate the expressive power and aesthetic quality of complex literary texts

components.description_pt: Analisar obras fundacionais da literatura portuguesa para compreender sua influência na história literária brasileira
components.description_en: Analyze foundational works of Portuguese literature to understand their influence on Brazilian literary history
components.cc_component_description: Analyze how an author draws on source material such as mythology or prior literature in a new work

components.description_pt: Reconhecer a historicidade de procedimentos estéticos comparando textos literários canônicos e brasileiros
components.description_en: Recognize the historicity of aesthetic procedures by comparing canonical and Brazilian literary texts
components.cc_component_description: Compare how two or more American literary texts from the same period treat similar themes

cc_matches.description: Apply grades 9—10 Reading standards to literature (e.g., "Analyze how an author draws on and transforms source material in a specific work [e.g., how Shakespeare treats a theme or topic from Ovid or the Bible or how a later author draws on a play by Shakespeare]").

Demonstrate knowledge of eighteenth-, nineteenth- and early-twentieth-century foundational works of American literature, including how two or more texts from the same period treat similar themes or topics.
Analyze a particular point of view or cultural experience reflected in a work of literature from outside the United States, drawing on a wide reading of world literature.

Por medio de su repertorio lingüístico y utilizando artefactos multimodales, los estudiantes bi/multilingües podrán interpretar relatos para...
* deducir la audiencia según el contexto y múltiples puntos de vista
* analizar personajes y sus actitudes en una serie de experiencias o eventos
* percibir ideas abstractas o sentimientos contradictorios descritos de manera multimodal y/o multilingüe
* comprender los mensajes explícitos e implícitos de textos multimodales bilingües
* evaluar la expresividad y potencia estética de textos
* identificar estilos o diferencias en énfasis en textos complejos
